channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Father, son charged with attempted murder
item.description: Wilson father, son charged with attempted first-degree murder after police say they shot at a man during an argument.

item.title: 18-year-olds charged with 4 attempted murders
item.description: Two 18-year-old Wilson men face four attempted murder charges; one suspect was already out on bond in a separate 2024 attempted murder case.

item.title: ‘I just thank God’: Family moving to new Habitat home
item.description: Mary Ann Silver and daughter Tonya Ruffin-Pitt are grateful for their new Habitat home on Lincoln Street. It's a community-built house they say they are grateful to call home.

item.title: Down to Business: Expo promotes Black-owned business
item.description: Wilson Community College’s third annual Black Business Expo showcases local Black-owned businesses while helping students build soft skills and connections as part of a Black History Month celebration.

item.title: Fashion show celebrates African attire
item.description: Traditional and contemporary African attire took center stage at the NAACP Wilson Branch Fashion Show, held Saturday at the Wilson County Agricultural Center.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 23-24, 2026
item.description: Local sports schedule for Feb. 23-24, 2026 featuring Barton College track, basketball, and volleyball plus NCHSAA and NCISAA high school basketball playoff games across multiple classifications.

item.title: Hunt’s Harris denied state title by a point
item.description: Hunt junior Judah Harris fell one point short of a 5-A state wrestling title in Greensboro but quickly refocused on national events ahead, while Zymir Best placed third and Lennon Ogden closed an outstanding sophomore season.

item.title: Warriors’ Jackson gets Shrine Bowl nod 43 years later
item.description: Forty-three years after a standout senior season ended in a Shrine Bowl snub, Hunt head coach Juan Jackson has been named an assistant for North Carolina in the 90th Shrine Bowl of the Carolinas.

item.title: Knights beat WCD a 3rd time to advance to NCISAA 2-A semis
item.description: Top-seeded Greenfield beat Wayne Country Day 75-59 for a third time this season, riding Kobe Edwards' all-around performance into the NCISAA 2-A semifinals vs Fayetteville Academy.

item.title: ‘Sweet 16’ area teams earn NCHSAA postseason invitations
item.description: Sixteen Times-area basketball teams are headed to the NCHSAA playoffs, with Fike boys and Wilson Prep girls snagging No. 2 seeds and several local squads opening at home or with first-round byes.
